provenance: LLM-backend-derived + deterministic-checked (Phase 16 inverted boundary — the LLM EXTRACTED the genuine red flags; the deterministic gate GROUNDS each verbatim `flag` in the source md + the red-flag relevance region and checks the cover×data matrix) — NOT a ship typology config. The deterministic extractor fragmented this advisory's (i)/(ii) sub-clauses into 7 noisy blocks; the LLM consolidated them to the 3 genuine enumerated indicators. build_rec follows the cover×data matrix (build_rec_category). Coverage/data values are ILLUSTRATIVE (vision demo).

indicators.flag: An account holder attempts to deposit one or more checks that appear to be issued by the U.S. Treasury, but are fraudulent or counterfeit checks.
indicators.rationale: Distinguishing a genuine U.S. Treasury EIP check from a fraudulent or counterfeit one needs Treasury check-authentication data (the Treasury Check Verification System) we hold only partially; build the deposit-time check-validity signal after wiring that enrichment.

indicators.flag: An existing account receives, or an account holder makes, multiple EIP-related deposits for individuals other than the account holder(s), and the individuals named on the checks reside outside the geographic region of the account holder, or do not have a history at the account holder’s purported address.
indicators.rationale: Multiple EIP deposits payable to non-account-holders with a geographic / address-history mismatch is an uncovered funnel-account pattern, and deposit payee names, addresses, and geography are all in repo — immediately buildable.

build_logic.logic: an account receives several EIP-type deposits (U.S. Treasury check, ACH, or prepaid card) payable to individuals other than the account holder, where at least three named payees reside outside the account holder's geographic region or have no history at the account address — a funnel-account pattern
build_logic.source: Core deposit + payee name/address features (Gold); EIP / U.S. Treasury check deposit typing
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → EIP-fraud / money-mule review gate

indicators.flag: An existing account receives an excessive number of EIPs via U.S. Treasury check or deposits related to a prepaid debit card linked to the same address.
indicators.rationale: An excessive count of EIP deposits aggregating to one address relative to the customer's profile is uncovered, and inbound EIP counts, address-cluster linkage, and the CDD expected-activity baseline are all in repo — immediately buildable.

build_logic.logic: one account, or a cluster of accounts linked to a single physical address, receives an excessive number of EIPs by U.S. Treasury check or prepaid-debit-card deposit — more inbound EIPs than the customer's due-diligence profile and expected activity predict
build_logic.source: Core deposit features (Gold); address-cluster linkage; CDD expected-activity baseline
